split: Second-recording temporal holdout-prefix diagnostic; no tuning on these outcomes
driven_by: Actual available-prefix raw-video ATLAS CV boundary crossings; original video incomplete and never claimed complete
conditioning: Development-only NGSIM geometry and turn probabilities; independent RSM schedule; SUMO chooses safe insertion speed. This is an approximate baseline, not a validated physical twin.

N.scope: Unpaired traversal distributions, not individual-vehicle travel-time prediction error; both endpoints inside the validation window

S.scope: Unpaired traversal distributions, not individual-vehicle travel-time prediction error; both endpoints inside the validation window

sb_queue_count.definition: <0.5 m/s at three consecutive 1 Hz samples (>=2 s), SB upstream band 1090–1250 local ft, lateral -55–0 ft; not physical queue-tail length

limitations: Incomplete turn bays, bus layby and midblock driveways
Approximate two-stage RSM phasing; signal lamps not independently decoded
CV missed/fragmented tracks and boundary misses propagate into reconstruction
Conditional counts/travel-time distributions do not establish per-vehicle physical accuracy or field intervention effects
Original 720-second final holdout is incomplete; only 471 quality-guarded seconds can be scored
This is aggregate temporal validation, not a vehicle-disjoint identity benchmark or full planned-window validation

source_availability.scope: Archive CRC establishes faithful download, not completeness of the originally published AVI. Incomplete source is rejected; only its explicit quality-guarded prefix is analyzed.

registration.method: Static SIFT second raw frame0 to first raw frame600, no second-recording trajectory calibration

derived_prefix.description: Exact consecutive source pixels, lossless FFV1; last 28 decoded parent frames excluded by the predeclared quality guard. No repair, interpolation or invented frames. This is not the complete original recording.
